contracts.order: Actual Rider -> one category spin/reaction -> one specific mount spin -> atomically register one mount, its exact numeric stat buff and (strong only) linked weapon -> actual result reaction -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Four equal categories: 25% each. Twelve equal outcomes in the selected category: 1/12 each. Every named mount has unconditional 1/48 probability. Four entries in each strength band give 1/3 per band; no extra strength-band draw.
contracts.quantity: Exactly one mount; no count, success/taming, strength-band, model, or extra subtype selector.
contracts.ownership: Mount is an owned separate entity linked to the Rider source. Owner race/body/Size stay separate; Titan is an external mount, not owner Titan transformation. Mecha is a ride/pilot entity, not Machine race/body conversion. Animals do not grant Taming Power or copy a Tamer event.
contracts.effects: Weak: +1 total numeric main-stat point. Moderate: +2 total numeric main-stat points. Strong: +1 total numeric main-stat point plus one weapon record for that same selected mount. Apply only the selected row, not stacked strength bands. No automatic Power grant or mastery rank bonus.
contracts.capability: Detailed animal traits, mounted functions/loadouts, operator/crew, fuel/ammunition, range, body-fit and control profiles remain configuration. Names do not grant all franchise forms/abilities or source-race events. Gustav Cannon is a heavy mounted platform; operation/crew must be defined, not inferred from its label.
contracts.body: Owner retains the one global Size spin. Missing mount-fit/embodiment rules require configuration, not an inferred enlargement, owner transformation or second owner Size draw.
contracts.ledger: Freeze both pools, odds, version, mount recipe, exact stat allocation and strong weapon reference before drawing. Commit mount/buff/linked weapon atomically using one result-source ledger key and distinct effect keys; replay restores the same records without another spin, duplicate modifier or second mount/weapon.
contracts.reaction: Append actual category, mount, band, declared numeric buff and strong-only weapon grant. Do not predict future base stats/mastery/Enchant. Short Gen Z captions; no joke explanation or new funny-result tag inferred from a name.
contracts.return: Return to Backstory after both actual child-spin reactions and mount registration; preserve earlier inventory and any caller continuation.
contracts.stat: Apply the frozen exact per-mount allocation once through source-keyed modifiers. +1/+2 means the total across the five main stats, not +1/+2 to every stat. Main-stat bases remain immutable; derive final values from all source modifiers without numeric clamps. Band total is metadata, not an additional buff.
contracts.weapon: All sixteen strong outcomes count as one owned weapon each when actually selected, including animals and unusual mounts. Link weapon instance to the same mount instance; no second entity or weapon acquisition selector. Retain after main Weapon None and resolve its one ordinary per-instance mastery at the normal Weapon stage. Effective Master or above opens compatible Enchant under existing rules; compatibility profiles remain configuration. Weak/moderate mounts grant no weapon or weapon mastery.
